title: muster skprofile run report
description: Machine-readable report emitted by `muster skprofile run <manifest> --json` (data-model.md SkProfileReport). Every finding cites source.normative: the pinned upstream schema URL for schema findings (FR-002), or a docs/rubric/spec-kitty-profile-taxonomy.md §clause for every other check class (FR-009).

ok.description: true iff findings[] contains zero severity:"error" entries, across the whole profile graph (independent of case coverage).

exitCode.description: 0 = ok; 1 = at least one error finding; 2 = the manifest (or projectionManifestPath) could not be read/parsed, or a required manifest path (profilesDir/schemaPath/doctrineRoot/activationConfigPath) was declared but missing.

findings.description: Authoritative, ungrouped, whole-graph finding set (data-model.md SkProfileFinding).

cases.description: Report-organization view only (research.md R1) — a filtered projection of findings[] by case.profileId, never an independent pass/fail gate.

kind.description: Draft vocabulary (plan.md research.md R6); docs/rubric/spec-kitty-profile-taxonomy.md (WP04) is the authoritative source for final naming/§-clause mapping.

profileId.description: The profile-id this finding concerns, or "(manifest)" for a manifest/schema-load-level finding not tied to one profile.

normative.description: For schema-conformance-violation: https://github.com/Priivacy-ai/spec-kitty/blob/<schemaSha>/src/doctrine/schemas/agent-profile.schema.yaml (FR-002). For every other kind: a docs/rubric/spec-kitty-profile-taxonomy.md §clause (FR-009).
